description: Costs, standards, barriers, attractions and alternatives all voiced.
transcript:
A: I do everything in this house. It is not fair and you know it.
B: I paid for the roof and the car. That is not nothing.
A: This is not what I signed up for. I deserve better than keeping score.
B: I don't want to lose this. I still choose you, even on the bad weeks.
A: Sometimes I think I would be happier on my own.
B: Because of the mortgage and the kids neither of us can just walk out anyway.
A: I am not saying I want to leave. I am saying I am tired.
B: Then let's find something that works for both of us.

gold.notes: Alternatives are voiced mid-conflict and must be coded as a speech act, never as a stability signal. 'the kids' is a third-party mention, not triangulation.
